title: Update VCF Installer depot settings with a download token
prompt: Implement `VcfInstallerClient.java` as a single-file Java 17 client using only the standard library. Preserve the scaffolded public API. `updateDepotSettings(String downloadToken)` must call the VCF Installer 9.0 `updateDepotSettings` operation: send `PUT /v1/system/settings/depot` with `Accept: application/json`, `Content-Type: application/json`, and the UTF-8 JSON body `{"vmwareAccount":{"downloadToken":"<JSON-escaped argument>"}}`. All unset optional `DepotSettings` and `DepotAccount` fields must be omitted, not emitted as empty strings, nulls, or empty objects. Treat HTTP 202 as success and return its response body; throw `IOException` for any other HTTP status. This PUT is an idempotent desired-state update, so separate invocations with the same token must produce byte-identical requests and be safe for a caller to retry after an ambiguous failure. Resolve the operation path against the constructor's loopback base URI. The pinned VCF 9.0 contract and provenance are in `docs/contract.json` and `docs/official_sources.json`; do not use a live VMware endpoint. Run `python3 tests/verify.py`. Edit only `VcfInstallerClient.java`; the test harness and `docs/**` are protected.
